methods.name: linearModeDecision
statements: p1 >= 0 ? (p1 > pMaxFromCS1toCS2 ? DECISION_TO_SATURATION_FROM_CS1_TO_CS2 : DECISION_NONE) : p2 > pMaxFromCS2toCS1 ? DECISION_TO_SATURATION_FROM_CS2_TO_CS1 : DECISION_NONE

methods.name: saturationModeDecision
statements: p1 > 0 && p1 < pMaxFromCS1toCS2 || p2 > 0 && p2 < pMaxFromCS2toCS1 ? DECISION_TO_LINEAR_MODE : p1 < 0 && status == STATUS_SATURATION_MODE_FROM_CS1_TO_CS2 ? DECISION_TO_SATURATION_FROM_CS2_TO_CS1 : p2 < 0 && status == STATUS_SATURATION_MODE_FROM_CS2_TO_CS1 ? DECISION_TO_SATURATION_FROM_CS1_TO_CS2 : DECISION_NONE

methods.name: decision
statements: status == STATUS_LINEAR_MODE ? linearModeDecision(p1, p2, pMaxFromCS1toCS2, pMaxFromCS2toCS1) : status == STATUS_SATURATION_MODE_FROM_CS1_TO_CS2 || status == STATUS_SATURATION_MODE_FROM_CS2_TO_CS1 ? saturationModeDecision(status, p1, p2, pMaxFromCS1toCS2, pMaxFromCS2toCS1) : DECISION_NONE
